pass: end-to-end equivalence pass, consumers at trace position
consumer_position: each recorded execute_python call runs before the attempt's next query_db call, with only the bindings present at that point (code/live.py run_system -> run_consumers); calls after the last query_db call run at attempt end
comparison: every S1/S2/S2c/S3 tool message, inline value, bound path and bound-file content compared with S0 on identical attempt orders (code/live.py _compare); S0 runs every consumer twice to detect nondeterministic agent code
